questions.question: Find the number of prime factor of 1024.
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Prime factor of 1024

⇒ 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 2

⇒ 2¹⁰

**∴ the number of prime factor of 1024 is 10.**

questions.question: What is the value of x⁴ + y⁴ when the value of x³ + y³ = 8 and x + y = 2?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

⇒ x3 + y3 = 8

⇒ x + y = 2

**Formula used:**

(x + y)2 = x2 + y2 + 2xy

x3 + y3 = (x + y) (x2 + y2 – xy)

**Calculation:**

⇒ x³ + y³ = (x + y) (x² + y² – xy)

⇒ 8 = 2 × {(x + y)² – 2xy – xy}

⇒ 4 = {2² – 3xy}

⇒ 3xy = 0

⇒ xy = 0

Now, (x + y)² = x² + y² + 2xy

⇒ 2² = x² + y² + 2 × 0

⇒ 4 = x² + y²

⇒ x² + y² = 4

Squaring both sides, we get

⇒ (x² + y²)² = x⁴ + y⁴ + 2x²y²

⇒ 4² = x⁴ + y⁴ + 2 × 0

⇒ x⁴ + y⁴ = 16

**∴ The correct answer is 16.**

questions.question: The radius of the circle is 14 cm, an arc is subtend an angle 54 degree at center. Find the length of the arc (in cm).
questions.solution:
We know, angle (radian) = arc/radius

⇒ 54 × π/180 = arc/14

⇒ 54 × 22/7 × 1/180 = arc/14

∴ arc = 13.2 cm

questions.question: If 5% of (P + Q) = 20% of (P – Q), then P is what percentage of Q?
questions.solution:
According to the question

⇒ 5% of (P + Q) = 20% of (P- Q)

⇒ 5/100 × (P + Q) = 20/100 × (P – Q)

⇒ (P + Q) = 4 × (P – Q)

⇒ P + Q = 4P – 4Q

⇒ 3P = 5Q

⇒ P/Q = 5/3

Let P = 5 & Q = 3

∴ Required % = 5/3 × 100 = 166.66%

questions.question: The average of three numbers is 40. The first number is 4/3 of the third number. If the third number is 20 less than the second number, then what is the value of the second number?
questions.solution:
Let the third number be 3x

So, the first number is 4x

And the second number = 3x + 20

We know, average = sum of all the observation/total number of observation

According to the question

Average = (4x + 3x + 20 + 3x)/3

⇒ (4x + 3x + 20 + 3x) = 40 × 3 = 120

⇒ 10x = 100

⇒ x = 10

∴ Second number = 3x + 20 = 3 × 10 + 20 = 30 + 20 = 50

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 4000 becomes Rs. 6000 in 1 year at a certain rate of compound interest. What will be the sum (in Rs.) after 4 years?
questions.solution:
A sum of Rs. 4000 becomes Rs 6000 in 1 year

So, Principal = 4,000 and SI = 6,000 – 4,000 = 2,000

We know, SI = (P × r × t) /100

⇒ 2,000 = (4,000 × r × 1) /100

⇒ r = 50%

According to the question

{{A}} = {{P}}{( {1 + frac{{{r}}}{{100}}} )⁴}

⇒ A = 4,000 × 3/2 × 3/2 × 3/2 × 3/2

⇒ A = 20250

∴ After 4 years, the sum will be Rs. 20250.

questions.question: Mukesh sells two shirts. The cost price of the first shirt is equal to the selling price of the second shirt. The first shirt is sold at a profit of 30% and the second shirt is sold at a loss of 30%. What is the ratio of the selling price of the first shirt to the cost price of the second shirt?
questions.solution:
First shirt is sold at a profit of 30%

We write 30% = 3/10

Let CP of the first shirt be 10 and profit be 3

So, SP of the first shirt = 10 + 3 = 13

(CP)₁/(SP)₁ = 10/13 ----(1)

Similarly second shirt is sold at a loss of 30%

We write 30% = 3/10

Let CP of the second shirt be 10 and loss be 3

So, SP of the second shirt be = 10 – 3 = 7

(CP)₂/(SP)₂ = 10/7 ----(2)

Given, CP of the first shirt is equal to the SP of the second shirt.

Multiply by 7 in equation (1) and multiply by 10 in equation (2) we get

CP)₁/(SP)₁ = 70/91

(CP)₂/(SP)₂ = 100/70

∴ ratio of the selling price of the first shirt to the cost price of the second shirt is 91 : 100

questions.question: The marked price of an article is 60% more than its cost price. What maximum discount percentage can be offered by the shopkeeper to sell his article at no profit or no loss?
questions.solution:
Let the CP of the article be 100

So, MP of the article = 100 × 160/100 = 160

If no profit or no loss, then discount % = (MP – CP) /MP × 100

∴ Required discount % = (160 – 100) /160 × 100 = 37.5%

questions.question: If 169 is subtracted from the square of a number, then the result obtained is 7056. What is the number?
questions.solution:
Let the number be x

According to the question

⇒ a² – 169 = 7056

⇒ a² = 7056 + 169

⇒ a² = 7225

⇒ a = 85

∴ Number is 85

questions.question: Working 5 hours a day, Shivam can read a book in 24 days. How many hours a day should he work so as to finish the same work in 8 days?
questions.solution:
We know, h₁ × d₁ = h₂ × d₂

So, h₁ = 5 hr, d₁ = 24 hr, d₂ = 8 & h₂ = ?

⇒ 5 × 24 = h₂ × 8

⇒ h₂ = 15 hours

∴ 15 hours a day he should work.

questions.question: Two trains are moving in opposite directions with the same speed. If the length of each train is 120 metres and they cross each other in 12seconds, then what is the speed (in km/hr) of each train?
questions.solution:
If opposite directions then,

Total Speed = S₁ + S₂

Given S₁ = S₂

Total distance = 120 + 120 = 240

Total time = 12 sec

We know, speed = distance/time

So, total speed = 240/12 = 20 m/sec

S₁ + S₂ = 20 m/sec

⇒ 2S₁ = 20 m/sec

⇒ S₁ = 10 × 18/5 = 36 km/hr

∴ The speed of each train is 36 km/hr

questions.question: If each applicant has to submit Rs. 500 as application fees, how much did the college collect (in Rs. lakhs) as application fees in the last three years?
questions.solution:
Number of students who applied in 2015 = 5,000

Number of students who applied in 2016 = 1,500

Number of students who applied in 2017 = 5,500

Total applications in 2015, 2016 and 2017 = 5,000 + 1500 + 5500 = 12,000

If application fees submitted by each applicant = Rs. 500

Then, the total fees collected by the college in the last three years = 12,000 × 500 = 60,00,000

Hence, the correct answer is **"60".**

questions.question: The area of a square is 72.25 cm². Find its perimeter (in cm).
questions.solution:
We know, area of the square = a²

And perimeter of the square = 4a

Area of the given square = 72.25

⇒ a² = 72.25

⇒ a = 8.5

∴ Perimeter of the given square = 4a = 4 × 8.5 = 34 cm

questions.question: Find the circumference (in cm) of a circle of radius 17.5 cm.
questions.solution:
We know, the circumference of the circle = 2πr

Given, radius of the circle = 17.5

∴ The circumference of the given circle = 2πr = 2 × 22/7 × 17.5 = 110

questions.question: The curved surface area and the diameter of a right circular cylinder are 352 cm² and 14 cm respectively. Find its height (in cm).
questions.solution:
**Given: **The curved surface area of cylinder = 352 cm2

The diameter of the cylinder = 14 cm

**Calculation:**

⇒ The radius of the cylinder = 14/2 = 7 cm

Formula: The curved surface area of the cylinder = 2πrh

⇒ 2πrh = 352

⇒ 2 × 22/7 × 7 × h = 352

⇒ h = 8 cm

∴ Height of the cylinder is 8 cm

questions.question: ∆XYZ is right angled at Y. If m∠Z = 60°, then find the value of (cot X – 1/3).
questions.solution:
We know, the sum of all the three angles of a triangle is 180

Given, ∠Z = 60 & ∠Y = 90

⇒ ∠X + ∠Y + ∠Z = 180

⇒ ∠X + 90 + 60 = 180

⇒ ∠X = 30

∴ cot X – 1/3 = cot30 – 1/3 = √3 – 1/3 = (3√3 – 1)/√3

Thus, the correct answer is option **1.**

questions.question: ∆PQR is right angled at Q. If sin P = 12/13, then what is the value of tan R?
questions.solution:
Given, sin P = 12/13 & ∠Q = 90

Sin P = Perpendicular/hypotenuse = RQ/PR = 12/13

RQ = 12k & PR = 13k

In right angled ∆PQR

By Pythagoras theorem

(PR)² = (PQ)² + (RQ)²

⇒ 13k² = (PQ)² + 12k²

⇒ (PQ)² = 25k cm

⇒ PQ = 5k

∴ tan R = PQ/RQ = 5/12
